thought.text: AVD created and NDK installed. Now configuring the environment and Flutter, then creating a debug keystore for the release build:

reasoning_content: The AVD has already been created. The NDK download is also complete (exit code 0). Next, I'll set the ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_SDK_ROOT environment variables persistently, and configure Flutter. After that, I'll create a keystore for release builds and run flutter doctor.

action.command: echo 'export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk' >> /root/.bashrc && echo 'export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk' >> /root/.bashrc && echo 'export PATH=$PATH:/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools:/opt/android-sdk/emulator' >> /root/.bashrc && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && fvm flutter config --android-sdk=/opt/android-sdk 2>&1 | grep -v "Woah\|superuser" | head -2; ls /opt/android-sdk/ndk/ 2>/dev/null
